effects.persistence: sometimes goes unnoticed for extended periods of time
constraints: knowledge is random in size and usefulness

evidence.locator: Subjects “entering” SCP-028 are, within three (3) to six (6) seconds, struck by total and complete knowledge of a subject.

constraints: the Effect has been experienced multiple times

evidence.locator: This Effect can be experienced multiple times by exiting and re-entering SCP-028, but can result in increasingly strong migraines and dizziness after two (2) exposures.
No special means are needed to contain at this time, as SCP-028 has not shown any change in size, position or shape during the entire period of its containment, but access must be restricted.
